name: Ruò Lièchē Bù Huì Lái Dehuà
source:
What if the train never comes…?

On Christmas Eve, Kazuya finds himself stranded at an unknown train station. As he wonders whether to wait for the next train, he encounters a mysterious silver-haired girl.

"How about... going on a date together?"

Should he keep waiting? Or go on a date with her? Your choice will change both of their fates.

[From [url=https://undefinedtales.itch.io/until-the-train-comes]itch.io[/url]]
